listen.description:
Listen address for the HTTP API (e.g. ":59179" or "127.0.0.1:59179"). Default: :59179.
The API has no authentication; prefer a loopback or host-local address.

read_header_timeout.description: Maximum time to read a request's headers. 0 disables. Default: 10s.

read_timeout.description: Maximum time to read a whole request (headers and body). 0 disables. Default: 30s.

write_timeout.description:
Maximum time to write a response, counted from the end of header read. Must cover
the slowest ad-hoc check (check.timeout) and the /metrics scrape. 0 disables. Default: 60s.

idle_timeout.description: Maximum time an idle keep-alive connection stays open. 0 disables. Default: 120s.

APIConfig.description: APIConfig configures the HTTP API server.

as_path_prepend.description: Number of times to prepend the local ASN to the AS_PATH while the VIP is healthy. Added to lower_priority.as_path_prepend when pessimized. Only effective over eBGP (prepends are not applied to iBGP peers). Default: 0.

communities.description: BGP communities attached to every announcement of this VIP (e.g. "65535:100"). Merged with lower_priority.communities when pessimized.

AnnounceConfig.description: AnnounceConfig defines base BGP attributes applied to every announcement of a VIP.

enabled.description: Enable BFD for this peer. Default: false.

port.description: UDP port for the BFD session. Default: 0 (BFD daemon default, typically 3784).

desired_minimum_tx_interval.description: Desired minimum BFD transmit interval in microseconds. Default: 0 (BFD daemon default).

required_minimum_receive.description: Required minimum BFD receive interval in microseconds. Default: 0 (BFD daemon default).

detection_multiplier.description: BFD detection time multiplier. Default: 0 (BFD daemon default, typically 3).

BFDConfig.description: BFDConfig configures Bidirectional Forwarding Detection for a BGP peer.

listen_address.description: Local address to listen for inbound BGP TCP sessions. If empty, falls back to router.local_address, then 0.0.0.0.

listen_port.description: TCP port to listen on for inbound BGP TCP sessions. Default: 179. Set to -1 to disable BGP listening entirely.

gobgp_api.description: Embedded GoBGP gRPC API configuration (used by gobgp CLI for debugging).

neighbors.description: List of BGP neighbors (peers) to establish sessions with.

BGPConfig.description: BGPConfig defines global BGP parameters and neighbors.

name.description:
Name of this check in logs, metrics (check label), /status and checks_policy
expressions. Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Defaults to
the check type; required when a VIP has several checks of the same type.

detailed_metrics.description:
Export check-type-specific metrics for this VIP (ping RTT histogram and packet loss,
HTTP status code and TLS certificate expiry, DNS rcode and answer count per name,
gRPC status code). Off by default to keep the metric set small.

interval.description: Interval between consecutive health checks. Default: 1s.

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a check to complete; must be less than interval. Default: 100ms.

rise.description: Number of consecutive successes required to mark healthy (HAProxy-style). Default: 1.

fall.description: Number of consecutive failures required to mark unhealthy (HAProxy-style). Default: 3.

http.description: HTTP check configuration (required when type is "http").

dns.description: DNS check configuration (required when type is "dns").

ping.description: Ping (ICMP) check configuration (required when type is "ping").

udp.description: UDP check configuration (required when type is "udp").

tcp.description: TCP check configuration (required when type is "tcp").

listen.description: Listening-socket check configuration (required when type is "listen").

sql.description: SQL check configuration (required when type is "sql").

kafka.description: Kafka check configuration (required when type is "kafka").

grpc.description: gRPC check configuration (required when type is "grpc").

CheckConfig.description: CheckConfig defines health check type, scheduling, and type-specific parameters.

names.description: DNS names to query. All must resolve successfully for the check to pass.

resolver.description: DNS resolver address (ip or ip:port). Defaults to VIP prefix IP.

port.description: DNS resolver port (used when resolver is an IP without port). Default: 53.

DNSCheckConfig.description: DNSCheckConfig defines a DNS health check.

host.description: Host to connect to. Defaults to VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

tls_insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Requires tls=true. Mutually exclusive with tls_ca_cert.

tls_ca_cert.description:
Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate file for TLS verification. Requires tls=true.
Mutually exclusive with tls_insecure.

tls_server_name.description:
TLS SNI server name used during the handshake and for certificate verification.
Requires tls=true. Defaults to the connect host.

method.description:
Full gRPC method path to call, e.g. "myapp.v1.Greeter/Hello".
Leading slash is optional. When empty (default), the standard gRPC Health
Checking Protocol is used (grpc.health.v1.Health/Check).

service.description:
Service name passed in the HealthCheckRequest when using the standard health
protocol (method is empty). Empty string means server-wide health check.

ok_codes.description:
gRPC status codes considered a passing result. Only used when method is set;
the standard health protocol always requires SERVING.
Values are gRPC status code names (case-insensitive): OK, Canceled, Unknown,
InvalidArgument, DeadlineExceeded, NotFound, AlreadyExists, PermissionDenied,
ResourceExhausted, FailedPrecondition, Aborted, OutOfRange, Unimplemented,
Internal, Unavailable, DataLoss, Unauthenticated. Default: ["OK"].

metadata.description: Additional gRPC metadata sent with each call (analogous to HTTP headers).

GRPCCheckConfig.description: GRPCCheckConfig defines a gRPC health check.

enabled.description: Enable embedded GoBGP gRPC API server. Default: false.

listen.description: gRPC listen address used when enabled. Supports host:port or unix:///path. Default: 127.0.0.1:50051.

GoBGPAPIConfig.description: GoBGPAPIConfig configures the embedded GoBGP gRPC API.

url.description: URL to check. Can be a full URL (https://example.com/healthz) or a path (/healthz). When a full URL is given, proto and Host header are derived from it.

proto.description: Protocol override. Derived from full URL if not set. Default: http.

host.description: Host to connect to and send in the Host header. Defaults to VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128 prefixes.

port.description: Port override. Defaults to 80 for http, 443 for https.

response_codes.description: List of acceptable HTTP response status codes. Default: [200].

response_text.description: Exact string that must be present in the response body.

response_regex.description: Regular expression that must match the response body.

response_jq.description: JQ expression evaluated against the JSON response body; check passes when the result is "true".

tls_insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Mutually exclusive with tls_ca_cert.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate file for TLS verification. Mutually exclusive with tls_insecure.

tls_server_name.description:
TLS SNI server name sent during the handshake and used for certificate verification.
Auto-defaults to the URL hostname for HTTPS checks when the connect host (host field)
differs from the URL hostname — covers bare-IP VIPs and k8s Service names alike.
Set explicitly to override.

proxy.description:
Forward HTTP(S) proxy URL (e.g. http://proxy.example:3128) to route the check through.
The check target is a regular URL the proxy resolves and fetches; the origin host is
derived from the url field, not from the VIP. user:pass@ in the proxy URL is supported
and sent as Proxy-Authorization. Mutually incompatible with tls_server_name-driven
connect-to-VIP semantics. Requires url to be a full URL.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with the check request.

keep_alive.description:
Reuse the TCP/TLS connection across checks (HTTP keep-alive). Off by default so
every check exercises a full connect and TLS handshake, including certificate
verification. Enable for fast intervals where handshake cost matters; note the
certificate is then only re-verified when the idle connection is dropped.

HTTPCheckConfig.description: HTTPCheckConfig defines an HTTP health check.

host.description: Broker host (IP or DNS name). Defaults to the VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

client_id.description: Client ID presented to the broker (visible in broker logs and quotas). Default: pathosd.

tls_insecure.description: Skip certificate verification. Requires tls=true. Mutually exclusive with tls_ca_cert.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for verification. Requires tls=true.

tls_server_name.description: TLS server name for SNI and verification. Defaults to host.

sasl.description: SASL authentication. Omit for an unauthenticated listener.

topic.description:
Topic that must exist with a leader for every partition. Empty: only
broker metadata is requested (cheap on large clusters).

min_brokers.description: Minimum number of brokers the metadata must list. Default: 1.

KafkaCheckConfig.description: KafkaCheckConfig defines a check that connects to a Kafka broker (API version negotiation, optional TLS and SASL) and requests cluster metadata.

mechanism.description: Mechanism: plain, scram-sha-256 or scram-sha-512. Required.

password.description: Password; use an environment placeholder (%{KAFKA_PASSWORD}) rather than a literal.

KafkaSASLConfig.description: KafkaSASLConfig holds SASL credentials for the Kafka check.

proto.description: Transport protocol of the socket: "tcp" or "udp". Required.

port.description: Local port the socket must be bound to. Required.

host.description:
Local address the socket must be bound to; a wildcard bind (0.0.0.0, ::)
also matches. Defaults to the VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

netns_pid.description:
Read the socket table of this process's network namespace (<procfs>/<pid>/net)
instead of pathosd's own. Use 1 with paths.procfs pointing at the host's /proc
to check host sockets from a container with its own network namespace.
Default: 0 (pathosd's namespace).

ListenCheckConfig.description: ListenCheckConfig defines a check that passes when a socket on this host is bound to the port: a listening TCP socket or any bound UDP socket.

otel_level.description:
Minimum log level for OTEL log export. Defaults to the console level when unset.
Set to a lower level than logging.level to send more detail to the OTEL receiver
while keeping the console output quieter (e.g. level: warn, otel_level: debug).

timestamps.description:
Prefix console log records with a timestamp. Default: false when stderr is the
systemd journal (journald stores its own timestamps), true otherwise.

as_path_prepend.description: Number of additional times to prepend the local ASN to the AS_PATH when pessimized, on top of announce.as_path_prepend. Default: 6.

communities.description: BGP communities to attach to pessimized route announcements (e.g. "65535:666").

LowerPriorityConfig.description: LowerPriorityConfig defines BGP attributes for pessimized announcements.

name.description: Human-readable name for this peer (used in logs and metrics).

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the BGP peer.

required.description: If true, all VIPs require this peer to be established. Default: false.

port.description: TCP port for the BGP session. Default: 179.

local_address.description: Local source address for active peering with this neighbor. If empty, falls back to router.local_address.

passive.description: Wait for the peer to initiate the connection instead of connecting actively.

enable_multihop.description: Enable eBGP multihop — required when the peer is not directly connected (e.g. loopback-based sessions).

multihop_ttl.description: IP TTL for eBGP multihop sessions. 0 means use GoBGP default (255). Must be >= 2 when set explicitly. Only used when enable_multihop is true.

bfd.description: BFD configuration for this peer. Requires a BFD daemon (e.g. FRR) running on the host.

auth_password.description:
TCP MD5 signature password (RFC 2385) shared with this peer. The kernel signs and
verifies every segment of the session, so a mismatch or a third host cannot open,
hijack or reset it. Keep the secret out of the file with a %{ENV_VAR} placeholder.
Linux limits the key to 80 bytes. Note: the embedded GoBGP gRPC API returns it in
peer configuration, so keep that API on a local socket.

enabled.description:
Master switch for all OTEL export. Default: true.
Set to false to disable OTEL entirely without removing the endpoint.

endpoint.description:
OTLP collector endpoint URL. If empty, OTEL export is disabled.
The URL scheme selects the transport protocol automatically:
  grpc://host:4317  — gRPC (plaintext)
  grpcs://host:4317 — gRPC (TLS)
  http://host:4318  — OTLP/HTTP (plaintext)
  https://host:4318 — OTLP/HTTP (TLS)

insecure.description:
Skip TLS certificate verification for all signals. Not recommended in production.
Can be overridden per signal.

headers.description:
Additional headers sent with every OTLP request (e.g. for API-key authentication).
Can be extended or overridden per signal.

traces.description:
Per-signal configuration. Each signal inherits the global endpoint, insecure, and headers
and is enabled by default. Use these to override per signal.

OTelConfig.description: OTelConfig configures OpenTelemetry export (traces, metrics, logs).

endpoint.description:
Per-signal endpoint URL. Overrides the top-level otel.endpoint for this signal.
Leave empty to inherit the global endpoint.
The URL scheme determines the transport: grpc:// or grpcs:// selects gRPC;
http:// or https:// selects OTLP/HTTP.

enabled.description: Enable this signal. Default: true (inherits the global otel.enabled value).

insecure.description:
Skip TLS certificate verification for this signal. Overrides the global otel.insecure.
Leave unset to inherit the global value.

headers.description:
Additional headers for this signal, merged on top of the global otel.headers.
Signal-level keys take precedence over global keys.

OTelSignalConfig.description: OTelSignalConfig configures a single OTEL signal (traces, metrics, or logs).

procfs.description:
Mount point of procfs. In a container mount the host's /proc at /host/proc
(read-only) and set this to "/host/proc". Default: /proc.

PathsConfig.description: PathsConfig points checks at the kernel filesystems, node-exporter style.

dst_ip.description: Destination IP address to ping. Defaults to VIP prefix IP.

src_ip.description: Source IP address for outgoing ICMP packets.

privileged.description: Use privileged raw ICMP socket mode. Requires root/CAP_NET_RAW. Default: false (unprivileged UDP mode).

count.description: Number of ICMP echo requests to send per check cycle. Default: 1.

interval.description: Interval between individual ICMP packets within a check cycle.

max_loss_ratio.description: Maximum acceptable packet loss ratio (0.0–1.0). Default: 0 (no loss allowed).

PingCheckConfig.description: PingCheckConfig defines an ICMP ping health check.

fail_action.description: Action to take when the health check fails: withdraw the route entirely, or lower its BGP priority.

lower_priority_file.description: Path to a drain lock file. When present and the check is healthy, the VIP is announced pessimized (using the lower_priority attributes) instead of at full priority, regardless of fail_action. Does not prevent withdrawal on failure. Useful for maintenance drains.

announce.description: BGP attributes applied to every announcement of this VIP, healthy or pessimized. Use it to rank this node below another healthy node for the same VIP (standby ordering).

lower_priority.description: BGP attributes used for pessimized announcements: on check failure when fail_action is lower_priority, and whenever lower_priority_file is present.

PolicyConfig.description: PolicyConfig defines how VIP state changes on check failure.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number for this router (1–4294967295).

router_id.description: BGP Router ID in dotted-quad notation (e.g. 10.0.0.1).

local_address.description: Local address to bind BGP sessions. If empty, the OS selects the source address.

local_address_ipv6.description:
IPv6 local address used as the next-hop (and listen address) for IPv6
VIP routes. Required when any VIP prefix is IPv6. This is separate from
local_address so an IPv4 peer source and IPv6 route next-hop can coexist.

host.description: Server host (IP or DNS name). Defaults to the VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

port.description: Server port. Default: 3306 for mysql, 5432 for postgres.

user.description: Login user. Required. Grant it only what the queries need.

password.description: Login password; use an environment placeholder (%{DB_PASSWORD}) rather than a literal.

database.description: Database to connect to. Optional for mysql; postgres defaults to the user name.

tls_insecure.description: Skip certificate verification. Requires tls=true. Mutually exclusive with tls_ca_cert.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for verification. Requires tls=true.

tls_server_name.description: TLS server name for SNI and verification. Defaults to host.

keep_alive.description:
Reuse the connection across checks. Off by default so every check
exercises connect and authentication.

queries.description: Queries to run in order on one connection. Default: a single "SELECT 1".

max_rows.description: Upper bound on rows fetched per query. Default: 100.

SQLCheckConfig.description: SQLCheckConfig defines a check that connects to a SQL server and runs queries.

name.description: Name used in details, metrics (query label) and errors. Default: q1, q2, …

result_jq.description:
jq expression evaluated against the rows as a JSON array of
{column: value} objects (numbers for numeric columns, strings otherwise);
must yield true. E.g. ".[0].Seconds_Behind_Source < 60" or
".[0].read_only == 0". Empty: the query only has to succeed.

SQLQueryConfig.description: SQLQueryConfig is one statement of a SQL check.

host.description: Host to connect to. Defaults to VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

port.description: TCP port to connect to. Required.

TCPCheckConfig.description: TCPCheckConfig defines a TCP port reachability check.

host.description: Host to send the probe to. Defaults to VIP prefix IP for /32 or /128.

payload.description: Payload to send with the probe datagram. Default: single null byte.

UDPCheckConfig.description: UDPCheckConfig defines a UDP port reachability check.

name.description: Human-readable name for this VIP (used in logs and metrics).

check.description: Health check for this VIP. Exactly one of check or checks is required.

checks.description:
Several health checks for this VIP, combined by checks_policy. Each entry is a full
check definition with its own interval, timeout, rise and fall. Exactly one of check
or checks is required.

checks_policy.description:
How the health of several checks combines into the VIP health: "all" (every check
must be healthy), "any" (one healthy check suffices) or a boolean expression over
the check names such as "web || (dns && ping)" (expr-lang syntax: && || ! and parentheses).
Default: all.

policy.description: Policy controlling how BGP announcements react to check failures.

require_local_address.description:
Fail the health check while the VIP address is not configured on a local interface,
so a route is never announced for an address this host cannot serve. Default: false.

local_interface.description: Interface the VIP address must be on for require_local_address (e.g. dummy-vip). Any interface when empty.

VIPConfig.description: VIPConfig defines a Virtual IP with its health check and policy.

api.description: HTTP API server configuration (healthz, metrics, status).

otel.description: OpenTelemetry export configuration (traces, metrics, logs). Disabled when endpoint is empty.

paths.description: Locations of kernel filesystems, for checks that read them.

bgp.description: BGP session parameters and neighbor definitions.

vips.description: List of Virtual IPs to announce via BGP, each with a health check.

title: pathosd configuration
description: Configuration schema for pathosd — health-aware BGP VIP announcer
